items.title: Freelancing and Remote Work Opportunities (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Freelancing and Remote Work Opportunities (PDF 133, printed 129).

blocks.text: Freelancing aur remote work logon ko online platforms ke zariye clients ko apni skills aur services pesh karne dete hain. Freelancers graphic design, writing, programming aur digital marketing jaise shobon mein kaam kar sakte hain. Remote work logon ko ghar se ya internet connection wali kisi bhi jagah se companies ke liye kaam karne deta hai. Yeh mauqe talaba aur professionals ko khud-mukhtar (independent) aamdani kamane mein madad dete hain. Yeh digital entrepreneurship ka aham hissa hain kyunke yeh lachak (flexibility) aur duniya bhar ki job markets tak rasai dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Freelancer kin shobon mein kaam kar sakta hai, aur remote work ka kya matlab hai?
blocks.explanation: Graphic design, writing, programming aur digital marketing. Remote work: ghar ya kisi bhi jagah se internet ke zariye kisi company ke liye kaam.

items: Freelancing: online platforms par clients ko skills aur services.
Remote work: lachak (flexibility) aur global job market.
